summary: Master risk management in banking with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with the skills to navigate financial challenges and safeguard assets.
lede: Bank risk management training helps credit, treasury, operational risk and audit professionals assess exposures and link controls to daily decisions. Participants practise assessing credit risk, designing key risk indicators and building liquidity stress scenarios through structured exercises. They also apply risk controls and reporting methods to approval, monitoring and escalation tasks, with activities suited to foundation-level learners and intermediate practitioners.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who contribute to banking risk decisions, controls, assurance, treasury oversight, or regulatory reporting. It suits foundation-level learners who need a structured view of banking risk and intermediate practitioners who need to connect frameworks with operational evidence.
audience: Banking Executives and Risk Committee Secretaries
modules: Market Risk and Banking Book Exposure
prerequisites: No formal banking risk certification is required. You should have basic familiarity with banking products, financial statements, lending, treasury, operations, or compliance processes. No programming is required. Spreadsheet skills are useful for the measurement exercises, while advanced credit modelling, regulatory interpretation, and production dashboard engineering remain outside the course scope.
